jobs.company: walkr - turn your Google Meet walk-friendly
jobs.description: Urban Walker Walkr â London (or another city with strong walkability) Full-time / Part-time considered Â· On-site (outdoors) About Walkr Walkr helps people turn everyday calls and meetings into walks. We started as a small Chrome extension that flags walk-friendly meetings in Google Calendar, and we're building toward a bigger mission: make walking the default way people connect, think and work. We believe most of what happens in a meeting room could happen just as well, if not better, on a pavement. We're now looking for someone to prove it, on the ground, every day. The role We're hiring a full-time Urban Walker: someone whose job is to walk. You'll take Walkr's calls, meetings and thinking sessions outdoors, on foot, in a city with enough walkable area to actually make that work. You'll be our internal proof of concept and our most honest source of product feedback. Practically, this means: Taking scheduled calls and 1:1s while walking, using Walkr to flag and organise them Logging what works and what doesn't: audio quality, routes, weather, pacing, how conversations change when nobody's looking at a screen Feeding that back into the product directly, you'll be in the room (or rather, on the street) with the team building the features you use Scouting and mapping walkable routes near our hubs that others on the team can reuse Occasionally representing Walkr in walking meetings with partners, press or early users What we're looking for You live in, or are willing to be based in, a city with genuinely walkable areas (parks, canals, low-traffic streets, decent pavements) You're comfortable holding a normal, focused conversation while moving, this is a real skill, not everyone has it You're organised enough to manage a calendar full of outdoor commitments and reroute around weather, meetings and life You're naturally curious about behaviour change, habits and how environment shapes how we think Bonus: you already walk a lot and have opinions about it Why this role exists Most companies talk about wellbeing and then put everyone back in a chair in a room with no windows. We'd rather have one person whose entire job disproves the excuse that walking meetings "don't really work in practice." If it's your job, it has to work. Vor jeder Verschiffung kommt ein Muster aus der laufenden Produktion zu dir. Du prüfst nach Maß, Werkstoff, Oberfläche und Funktion, dokumentierst das Ergebnis im Erstmusterprüfbericht und entscheidest, ob die Ware rausgeht. Ohne dein Ja bewegt sich nichts. 🛠️ Du baust die Prüfsystematik auf. Prüfvorschriften je Warengruppe und je Artikel, Stichprobenumfang und Annahmezahlen nach AQL, Freigabemuster als verbindlicher Vergleichsmaßstab, Rückverfolgbarkeit von jedem Befund zu Charge und Lieferant. Reproduzierbarkeit ist der Anspruch: Dieselbe Prüfung muss in zwei Jahren dasselbe Ergebnis liefern. 🛠️ Du prüfst nach, was tatsächlich angekommen ist. Wenn die Charge im Lager eintrifft, kommt ein Muster daraus zu dir und wird gegen das verwahrte Freigabemuster abgeglichen. Genau hier fallen die Fälle auf, in denen etwas anderes geliefert wurde als freigegeben. Denn nicht nur die erste Lieferung muss stimmen, sondern die zwanzigste auch. 🛠️ Du prüfst über das gesamte Sortiment. Handwerkzeug vom Hammer über Schraubendreher, Zangen und Schlüssel bis zu Messwerkzeug und Schutzausrüstung. Und Elektrowerkzeug-Zubehör: Bohrer, Bits, Säbelsägen-, Stichsägen- und Kreissägeblätter, Schleifmittel. Handwerkzeug beurteilst du statisch, Zubehör nur unter Last — mit definiertem Prüfwerkstoff und Abbruchkriterium, damit Standzeiten vergleichbar bleiben. 🛠️ Du machst Qualität messbar. Fehlerquoten je Lieferant, Warengruppe und Charge, Reklamations- und Rückläuferquoten je Artikel, qualitätsbezogene Lieferantenbewertung. Damit im Einkauf mit Zahlen entschieden wird und nicht mit Eindrücken. 🛠️ Du gehst Kundenfehlern auf den Grund. Reklamationen, Rückläufer und Produktbewertungen sind die schnellste Qualitätsmeldung, die wir bekommen — schneller als jeder Lieferantenbericht. Du liest sie als Befund, ordnest sie der Charge zu und schließst den Kreis zum Lieferanten. 🛠️ Du steuerst unsere externen Prüfinstitute. Wo eine Norm eine akkreditierte Prüfung verlangt — VPA, TÜV, VDE — holst du Angebote, beauftragst, verfolgst Termine und bewertest die Berichte. Du behältst den Überblick, welche Norm für welche Warengruppe gilt. 🛠️ Du richtest unsere Prüfwerkstatt ein. Prüfplätze, Messmittel, Prüfwerkstoffe, Prüfmittelverwaltung mit Kalibrierintervallen. Du entscheidest mit, mit welchem Equipment du arbeitest. 🛠️ Du arbeitest mit unserem QC-Officer in Asien zusammen. Er prüft vor Ort in den Werken, du bewertest seine Berichte und gibst die Prüfanforderungen vor. Zwei Kontrollpunkte, ein System. Dein Impact nach 12 Monaten 🛠️ Es gibt eine Prüfsystematik, nach der auch jemand anderes prüfen könnte — mit Prüfvorschriften, AQL-Niveaus und Freigabemustern für die wichtigsten Warengruppen. 🛠️ Keine Sendung verlässt die Produktion ohne dokumentierte Freigabe. Und die Prüfung ist trotzdem kein Nadelöhr. 🛠️ Jeder Befund ist zu Charge, Lieferant und Produktionszeitraum zurückverfolgbar. 🛠️ Es gibt ein monatliches Qualitätsreporting, das im Einkauf tatsächlich benutzt wird. 🛠️ Reklamationen und Rückläufer sind messbar zurückgegangen, weil Fehler bei dir auffallen und nicht beim Kunden. 🛠️ Die Prüfwerkstatt steht, ink

jobs.title: Sales Development Representative (SDR)
jobs.description: Sales Development Representative Edinburgh Wordsmith Wordsmith is building the legal operations platform for in-house teams, and we are growing fast. We believe in-house legal is becoming one of the most important functions in the AI era. Every business is moving faster, but legal work is still too often scattered across inboxes, chats, documents, and disconnected systems. Wordsmith brings that work into one system. Requests come in from across the business, AI agents handle the routine, lawyers stay in control where judgment matters, and every step is captured as work happens. We are built for in-house legal, not law firms. Our goal is to help legal teams move faster, reduce unnecessary external counsel spend, and become a function the business can run with. More than 500 companies, including Financial Times, Safelite, Trip.com, Canva, Starling, and Sage, use Wordsmith. Backed by $100M from Index Ventures, General Catalyst, Highland Europe, and others, we are building one of the defining companies in legal AI. The Role We’re hiring a Sales Development Representative (SDR) to spearhead our outbound engine and book high-quality opportunities with in-house legal teams. This is the frontline of our growth. You’ll be responsible for finding the right accounts, crafting compelling outreach, and breaking into companies. You’ll work hand-in-hand with our Account Executives (AEs) and Marketing teams to build a predictable pipeline. This is an early-stage environment. Things move fast, priorities shift, and there isn’t always a clear playbook. You’ll need to be resilient, highly organized, and willing to experiment with new ways to get a prospect’s attention. What you’ll do Build and execute targeted outbound campaigns (email, cold calling, LinkedIn) to general counsel and legal leaders. Consistently hit and exceed monthly meeting-booked and pipeline targets. Partner closely with AEs to strategize on key accounts and ensure smooth handoffs. Act as a feedback loop for Marketing and Product by tracking what messaging resonates most with the market. Maintain meticulous CRM data — keeping track of accounts, prospects, and outreach activity. What we’re looking for SaaS sales or lead generation experience (experience selling to legal, finance, or compliance is a major plus, but not required). A relentless work ethic — you aren't afraid of the phone and view "no" as data, not a deterrent. Strong written and verbal communication skills; you can cut through the noise with clear, value-led messaging. High curiosity and coachability; you want to master the product, the market, and the art of sales. High ownership — you take responsibility for outcomes, not just logging activities. Organized, consistent, and reliable with excellent time management. How we work We’re an in-office team. We work together because it makes us faster, sharper, and more effective. You should expect to be in the office our out visiting clients as your default. This is a high performance environment. We set a high bar, move quickly, and expect people to take ownership of real problems. There isn’t always a clear path. The people who do well here figure things out, stay close to the work, and keep pushing until they get to the right outcome. This role requires patience, structure, and strong judgement. You’ll be trusted to run complex deals with a high degree of autonomy. Why Wordsmith We’re in a period of strong momentum — growing quickly, winning new customers, and expanding into larger accounts. The product is landing well, the market is ready, and the team is scaling to meet demand. If you want to be in the room, close meaningful deals, and grow quickly in a high bar environment, this is one of the best places to do it. jobs.title: Senior Accountant - IFRS
jobs.description: About Pleo Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’. The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years. Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together. About the role We're looking for a Senior Accountant / Financial Reporting specialist to join our Finance Team at Pleo. In this role, you'll help strengthen core accounting execution, audit management, and monthly consolidated results analysis while being part of a high-growth environment as we scale our financial infrastructure. If you're excited about leveraging AI and automation to redefine modern accounting with a strong focus on IFRS excellence and financial rigor, then this is the opportunity for you! Who you’ll be working with and reporting to You’ll report to our Accounting Associate Director and work closely with teams across the Finance organisation. You will be part of a team dedicated to technical rigor and operational efficiency, partnering with cross-functional departments to elevate our accounting processes to the next level. What you’ll be doing As a Senior Accountant, you will: Prepare and post journal entries, perform balance sheet reconciliations, and drive high standards for period close improving quality and speed. Own the preparation of audit schedules, coordinate responses to requests, and drive the closure of audit questions to ensure a predictable, well-documented process. Deep dive into monthly results, flagging risks, unusual transactions, and key movements while providing decision-ready insights for finance leadership. Identify accounting risks, implement practical mitigations, and strengthen internal controls to ensure our processes are scalable and accurate. Actively leverage AI tools to improve efficiency and consistency, identifying opportunities to standardise and simplify recurring accounting work. What you bring You’ll thrive in this role if you have: 6+ years of experience with a strong ability to apply IFRS in real-world scenarios. Comfort working with consolidated results, analysing variances, and exercising complex accounting estimates and judgments. Proven experience managing audits end-to-end or acting as the primary finance contact for external auditors. A track record (or clear potential) of using AI and automation to improve accounting outcomes and efficiency. The ability to operate effectively in a fast-changing environment with an "ownership mindset" and excellent judgment. Strong ability to translate complex accounting issues into scalable process improvements and clear insights for stakeholders. Why is this role a good fit for you This role is a good fit for you if: You want genuine agency at group level rather than executing instructions handed down by a central team You'd rather design a process than inherit one, and you want to see your own work implemented You like variety. This is a different topic most days, not a fixed monthly cycle This role is not a good fit for you if: You want a settled, mature environment where the process is set

If you're ready to help shape the future of prediction markets with cutting-edge technology and a customer-first philosophy, Smarkets is where you belong. We welcome applications from candidates who are genuinely energised by the challenge of building a brand and a growth engine at scale, and who have the track record to prove it. We look forward to reviewing your application. The Team This role sits at the heart of our commercial strategy, overseeing marketing teams and working shoulder-to-shoulder with product, trading, data, and the executive team to grow the business. Prediction markets and exchange products are having a moment, and the team's job is to capture that energy: building the Smarkets brand and the brands within our group, and making every pound of the marketing budget work harder than the last. You’ll have autonomy and the trust to make good decisions and move quickly. It is an ownership role for the infrastructure they run on.</p> <p>You will join the Growth team to own an assigned domain within the GTM stack end to end: scoping, building, shipping, and running production systems that move ARR. jobs.title: Senior Partner Deployed Engineer
jobs.description: The Role We are looking for a Senior Partner Deployed Engineer to join the Customer Solutions team, focused on building Coder’s partner ecosystem across EMEA. This is a new function at Coder, modeled on the Forward Deployed Engineer role pioneered by companies like Palantir and now the fastest-growing technical role at frontier AI companies. The difference: instead of embedding with a single customer to deploy a platform, you embed with strategic partners to help them understand, position, and deliver Coder’s platform across their entire customer base. You are part Field CTO, part Industry Strategist, part Technical Specialist, and part Partner Relations Lead. You will be the technical authority within our EMEA partner ecosystem: setting the vision for how Coder fits into each partner’s AI, cloud, and modernization offerings, co-creating the GTM sales plays that partner sellers take to market, building the demonstrations and workshops that generate pipeline, and producing the Partner Relations content that establishes Coder’s technical brand in the ecosystem. This is not a support role. You are equally comfortable holding a strategic roadmap conversation with a partner CTO and debugging a Kubernetes deployment in a partner’s lab in the same afternoon. You are energized by the challenge of building a new category through partnerships, motivated by the multiplied impact of enabling an entire ecosystem rather than a single customer, and capable of operating with full autonomy in a fast-moving startup environment. What You’ll Do Serve as the strategic technical thought partner to EMEA partner leadership, including practice leads, CTOs, and solutions architects at global systems integrators, regional cloud consultancies, and hyperscaler field teams. Own the technical relationship and set the vision for how Coder fits into each partner’s AI and modernization portfolio. Co-create sales plays tailored to each partner’s customer base, vertical focus, and services capabilities. Author Working Backwards outcome proposals for strategic partner-customer combinations that translate AI Development Infrastructure into deal-level urgency. Develop and deliver workshops, Builder Labs, and partner-hosted enablement sessions as the primary awareness and demand generation vehicle for the EMEA ecosystem. Build hands-on demonstration environments and interactive experiences that partners can use independently. Intervene directly on the highest-value partner-attached deals across EMEA: co-sell calls, technical discovery, PoV scoping, architecture review, and technical win support. Own the engagement until the partner’s team can carry it independently. Transform bespoke partner enablement sessions into structured LMS modules and certification tiers that scale across the EMEA partner base without requiring live PDE support for each new partner. Produce “better together” reference architectures for strategic partner combinations across cloud providers and AI platforms. Include deployment diagrams, network topology, IAM patterns, and operational runbooks that partner SAs can hand directly to customers. Codify each successful partner engagement into a repeatable GTM play: trigger conditions, discovery questions, positioning framework, demo script, PoV scope template, and expected outcomes. Build a playbook library that a new PDE or partner seller can pick up and run. Build AI-powered self-service tools that automate high-volume PDE activities: Opportunity Brief Generator, PR/FAQ Generator, Workshop-in-a-Box deployment, and demo site builder. Produce a monthly partner intelligence digest from EMEA engagements: what customers are asking for, how competitors are positioning, where integrations are missing, which vertical use cases are emerging. Distribute to Product, Engineering, and GTM leadership. Own the EMEA-relevant portions of the joint technical integration roadmap with strategic partners. jobs.title: Infrastructure engineer (UK)

As an Infrastructure engineer, you'll be at the heart of making this a reality, impacting every enterprise customer who trusts us with their AI-powered workflows. This isn't just about keeping the lights on; it's about pushing the boundaries of what's possible, proactively identifying and solving complex systemic challenges, and laying the groundwork for our rapid growth and the evolving demands of enterprise generative AI. You'll build resilient systems, automate across the stack, and champion reliability best practices, directly enabling our ambitious product roadmap and ensuring our customers always have access to the powerful tools they need. This is a hybrid position, based out of our New York City or London hubs. You'll report to our director of engineering. 🦸🏻‍♀️ What you'll do Technical Breadth across disciplines. Bring deep focus to one problem at a time, with the breadth to move between SRE, DevOps, Infrastructure, and Platform work over a quarter or two as the leverage shifts. jobs.title: Senior Manager - Incentives
jobs.description: This role sits within the Onboarding & Incentives pillar of the Rider Growth function at Deliveroo, this pillar owns the journey from the moment an applicant expresses interest through to a fully habituated, retained rider. We collaborate closely with Product, Data Science, Regional Operations, Rider Marketing and the Retention team to secure and retain a high-quality fleet. We are seeking a Senior Manager to own three of the core engines behind our rider supply strategy: incentives, performance tracking, and target setting with scope to own wider areas of responsibility as these solutions are productionised. You will have overall accountability of our rider referral program from strategy to execution. You’ll partner closely with the Retention & Resurrection team on retention incentives, ensuring incentive spend across the rider lifecycle is efficient, well-targeted, and joined up. As part of this, you’ll design the governance frameworks needed to ensure all incentives across referrals, retention, resurrection and activation are operating efficiently and tests are designed robustly. You will also own performance tracking of rider hours end-to-end, partnering with teams across acquisition, conversion, activation, and retention to understand the forecast and actuals behind their initiatives, and working with Data Science to attribute causality to that work – giving senior stakeholders an accurate, defensible read on how our supply investments are performing. Finally, you will own our rider applicant target-setting model which is used to determine our rider acquisition forecasts vs top-down targets, working with Science and local Regional Operations teams. Improvements here will ensure we’re able to plan for longer time horizons with greater degrees of accuracy as well as scenario planning with our Rider Marketing team to drive efficiencies in cost per applicant. What we’re looking for Analytical Rigor : You are highly comfortable building and defending forecasting, target-setting, and attribution models, and can translate complex data into clear, actionable recommendations. Ownership & Follow-Through : You take full accountability for the incentives and reporting you own, proactively flagging risks to plan and driving fixes end-to-end. Cross-Functional Collaboration : You work effectively across Data Science, Regional Operations, Retention & Resurrection, and Rider Marketing to align on shared goals and targets. Stakeholder Communication : You can distil complex performance and target-setting narratives into clear, credible updates for senior stakeholders. What you'll be doing Referral & Reactivation Incentives : Own the end-to-end strategy, performance, and budget for rider referral and reactivation incentive programmes, continuously testing and iterating to improve efficiency. Retention Incentive Partnership : Partner closely with the Retention & Resurrection team on retention incentives, ensuring a joined-up approach to incentive spend across the rider lifecycle. Rider Hours Performance Tracking : Own tracking of rider hours performance, partnering with teams across acquisition, conversion, activation, and retention to understand the forecast and actuals behind their initiatives. Causal Attribution : Partner with Data Science to attribute causality to individual initiatives’ contribution to rider hours, building a robust and defensible measurement framework. Senior Stakeholder Reporting : Ensure rider hours performance and initiative impact are reported accurately and clearly to senior stakeholders on a regular cadence. Weekly Applicant Target Setting : Own the weekly rider applicant target-setting process, ensuring targets reflect the latest view of demand, funnel performance, and onboarding capacity. Annual Planning : Lead applicant target setting within the annual planning cycle, working with Science and local Regional Operations teams to work back from onboard targets to applicant targets. Typical problems you'll solve: What new benefits should we launch for Subscription - which ideas are worth pursuing, and what's the business case for each? How do we prioritise and sequence a pipeline of benefit ideas against limited engineering, design, and operational capacity? How do we define success for a new benefit before launch - what does a good outcome look like, and what would tell us to kill it? Once live, how is a benefit actually performing - impact on acquisition, retention, frequency, and member satisfaction - against its cost to serve, and what does that tell us to do next? How do we take a benefit from a small pilot to a scaled, steady-state feature, and what needs to be true operationally for that to work? What you'll be doing Own the strategy and roadmap for new benefits within Subscription - build the analysis, the business case, and the plan, and drive it through to execution. Track ongoing performance - maintain visibility into each live benefit's impact on acquisition, retention, frequency, and satisfaction against its cost to serve, flagging when something needs attention. Scale what works - take benefits from small pilots to steady-state features, defining the operating model, reporting cadence, and processes needed to run them sustainably. Bring outside-in perspective - track what Uber One, DashPass, Wolt+, Just Eat and Amazon Prime are doing with membership benefits, and translate what's relevant into Deliveroo's context. We're organized across two squads and one strategic program: Shipping Core squad – BackShip (managed labels, carrier network, billing, warranty), transit time infrastructure, carrier optimization, and collection point UX Delivery Experience (DXP) squad – Customer-facing delivery promise (PDP, Cart, Checkout), post-dispatch tracking, and delivery notifications BFF program – Back Market's logistic infrastructure, which integrates our fulfillment, trade-in, and B2B operations. It's both a seller-facing product and the core infrastructure layer that will power Back Market's own fulfillment operations (BFF) at scale. Currently, BackShip sees a minority of our sellers using the service. We aim to significantly grow this adoption rate in the coming years, which is expected to generate substantial additional revenue. jobs.description: Company Description We’re Checkout.com . You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day. We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers. Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale. If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact. With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started. About the role: As a Senior Software Developer at Checkout.com , you will be embedded within the Identity Verification Team, a critical function focused on building innovative products to verify the identities of individuals and businesses globally. In this high-impact role, you will be instrumental in the development of next-generation verification features, deploying intelligent, production-ready solutions by leveraging state-of-the-art Orchestration technologies as well as Generative AI and Computer Vision technologies. You will be expected to work closely and collaboratively with Product, DevOps, DataScientist, and Data teams to ensure successful, end-to-end delivery of these solutions, while constantly researching and integrating emerging technologies. A core part of your contribution will be safeguarding data integrity and ensuring compliance, and translating complex data insights into clear, actionable recommendations for stakeholders to support informed, data-driven decision-making across Checkout.com . What you will be doing: • Drive the design and development of innovative, complex and scalable applications for real-world identity verification challenges in a wider microservices using industry best practices. • Take full ownership of new and existing features and service, managing the end-to-end lifecycle from initial conceptualization and design through to deployment and monitoring in a production environment. • Actively collaborate with cross-functional teams (Engineering, Product, Risk) across the company to maximize the positive impact of data science initiatives. • Champion a culture of technical excellence, cross-team learning, and knowledge sharing within the Data organization. • Be part of, and collaborate with, cross-functional teams including product management, across a large engineering community. • Write clean, maintainable, extendable and testable code on some of Checkout’s most impactful systems. • Build, own and operate your systems to the highest levels of resilience and service. • Mentor junior team members and assist in their technical development What are we looking for: • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field • Over 5 years of experience as a Software Engineer working with complex, large-scale, and diversified applications and tech stacks. • Proficiency in C# .NET, with a strong understanding of software development principles in either a backend or full stack environment. • Great communication skills and ability to interact effectively with a wide range of stakeholders • Experience working in agile environments and delivering high-quality code within tight deadlines • Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently as well as part of a team • Someone who is AI proficient or AI curious, you will be hungry to embrace what the latest technology has to offer to enhance yours and your teams productivity • Payments or financial knowledge is a plus, but not a necessity • French language proficiency at a minimum B

jobs.title: Team Leader, Operations
jobs.description: Company Description We’re Checkout.com . You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day. We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers. Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale. If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact. With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started. Mission Statement The Team Leader, Production serves as the primary architect of operational output and staffing excellence. By merging the analytical rigor of capacity planning with direct floor management, this role ensures the seamless execution of verification tasks across multiple sites. The Production Team Leader is responsible for the optimization of resource allocation to meet global SLAs while maintaining data integrity and cost-efficiency. 1. Management of Operators & Performance Direct Leadership: Build and mentor a high-performance team of operators. Culture & Alignment: Foster a unified "One Team" culture between internal staff and BPO partners, ensuring that productivity and quality standards remain consistent across all locations. Performance Frameworks: Design and oversee individual performance monitoring frameworks to establish a fair, transparent, and objective system for measuring productivity and operational impact. 2. Staffing & Capacity Planning Capacity Planning: Develop and maintain sophisticated capacity planning models. Ensure these models are continuously updated to reflect new product launches and evolving methodologies, providing accurate staffing forecasts. Demand Management: Collaborate with Customer Success teams to forecast merchant activity and adjust staffing levels dynamically, ensuring strategic and effective resource utilization. 3. Multi-Site Oversight & BPO Synchronization Multi-Site Governance: Directly manage and synchronize production across multiple sites, ensuring contractual SLA adherence and cost-efficiency through rigorous performance reviews. Operational Blueprint: Maintain master documentation for all production activities, including data access protocols, staffing workflows, and incident management plans. 4. Business Continuity & Crisis Readiness Business Continuity Plan: Organize and maintain Business Continuity Plans (BCP) to ensure the Operations department can respond immediately to major disruptions across internal and BPO sites. Incident Frameworks: Maintain the "Gold Standard" for incident response, ensuring documented and efficient on-call rotations and escalation paths. Oversee the drafting of all post-mortem incident reports. Operational Policy: Regularly evaluate and update the operational policy regarding merchant prioritization to align with Account Management objectives and maintain adequate operational buffers. Post-Mortem Integration: Ensure that findings from incident post-mortems are systematically translated into documentation updates or training modules, driving continuous improvement. 5. Infrastructure & Workflow Optimization Hypervision Dashboarding: Maintain real-time visibility into operational health by managing live monitoring dashboards and advanced capacity planning tools. Automation Stewardship: Identify manual bottlenecks on the production floor and implement automated solutions or workflow optimizations to streamline verification processes. jobs.title: Representant(e) commercial(e) - Team lead - Strasbourg
jobs.description: Salonkee est l'une des entreprises beauty-tech à la croissance la plus rapide en Europe. Nous aidons des milliers de salons à simplifier leurs opérations quotidiennes et à offrir une expérience client hors du commun. Notre logiciel tout-en-un simplifie la prise de rendez-vous, les paiements et la gestion client, permettant ainsi aux professionnels de se concentrer sur l'essentiel : délivrer une prestation exceptionnelle. Nous sommes fiers de façonner l'avenir de l'industrie de la beauté grâce à l'innovation, la collaboration et une approche résolument humaine. Notre ancrage en France est déjà un succès incontestable. Face à une demande qui explose et pour soutenir cette dynamique, nous passons à la vitesse supérieure et recherchons nos prochains leaders sur le marché français. L'opportunité : Soyons clairs dès le départ Ce poste n'est pas un poste de manager classique. Pendant les 6 premiers mois, tu es sur le terrain, en tant que commercial(e) à part entière avec des objectifs de vente individuels, comme chaque membre de l'équipe. Pourquoi ? Parce que chez Salonkee, on ne peut diriger que ce que l'on maîtrise. Avant de coacher une équipe sur la prospection, les démos et le closing, tu dois connaître le marché, les salons et notre produit sur le bout des doigts. C'est notre garantie de qualité pour toi, pour ton équipe, et pour nos clients. Si tu cherches un rôle de management à distance, derrière un tableau Excel, ce poste n'est pas fait pour toi. Si tu veux gagner ta légitimité sur le terrain avant de prendre les rênes, continue à lire. Tes missions Phase 1 : Tu vends. Prospection terrain : Tu démarches activement les salons de coiffure et instituts de beauté de ta zone; porte-à-porte, démos en direct, closing. Objectifs individuels : Tu portes les mêmes objectifs de vente qu'un(e) commercial(e) terrain. Ta performance est mesurée, suivie, et récompensée. Apprentissage du marché : Tu comprends dans le détail les besoins des salons, les objections récurrentes et ce qui fait signer un·e gérant·e. Maîtrise des outils : CRM impeccable, pipeline propre, reporting fiable; tu appliques ce que tu exigeras plus tard de ton équipe. Phase 2 : Tu construis et tu diriges. Constitution de ton équipe : Tu participes au recrutement et fais grandir ton équipe jusqu'à environ 5 personnes (et plus en cas de succès). Lead by example : Tu passes plus de 80 % de ton temps sur le terrain avec ton équipe; tu accompagnes et tu coaches la prospection, tu assistes aux démos et tu aides activement à transformer les opportunités en signatures. Structure & coaching : Tu organises la semaine, tu animes les 1:1 et les roleplays, tu lèves les obstacles rapidement et tu veilles à la rigueur du CRM de toute l'équipe. Pilotage par les chiffres : Tu connais les indicateurs clés de chaque membre de ton équipe et tu pilotes activement la performance. Culture & motivation : Tu crées des challenges d'équipe, tu renforces la culture sales et tu fais en sorte que chacun(e) progresse en continu. Ton profil Passion pour la vente terrain : Au moins 3 à 4 ans d'expérience en vente terrain / commerce itinérant (le B2B est un plus). Tu adores être en première ligne. Potentiel de leadership : Tu n'as pas besoin d'avoir déjà été manager, mais tu as l'envie et le talent de prendre la responsabilité d'une région et de mener une équipe au succès. Autonomie & sens stratégique : Tu planifies tes activités en toute autonomie, tu fixes des priorités claires et trouves des moyens intelligents d'implanter Salonkee dans ta région. Affinité tech : Bonne compréhension des solutions digitales et solide expérience des CRM. Mobilité : Permis B indispensable, Tu gères en totale autonomie la région de Strasbourg et alentours. Langues : français natif. Un anglais professionnel est apprécié pour collaborer avec nos équipes internationales.. jobs.description: Here at The Exploration Company, we are building innovative aerospace technologies that advance the future of space transportation. We are looking for an Avionics Systems Engineer to support the design, development, integration, and validation of spacecraft avionics systems. The role focuses on delivering robust and reliable electronic systems for data handling, communications, and control across all mission phases. The engineer will contribute to system architecture definition, interface management, verification activities, and requirements engineering, while working closely with multidisciplinary teams and external stakeholders. In this role, you might be assigned to different avionics systems of the spacecraft. Key Responsibilities System Design & Architecture Define and develop avionics system architectures , including electronics, data handling, and communication functions. Ensure end-to-end consistency of data flows, interfaces, and system-level requirements . Support selection and definition of avionics equipment, computing platforms, sensors, and communication hardware. Contribute to spacecraft-level trade-offs between performance, reliability, mass, power, and cost. Ensure reliable data acquisition, processing, storage, and transmission under mission constraints. Contribute to bandwidth, timing, and data budget analyses. Integration & Interface Management Define and manage interfaces between avionics and other spacecraft subsystems (power, propulsion, GNC, payload, etc.). Ensure compatibility between spacecraft, launch vehicle, and ground segment interfaces. Coordinate interface definitions with internal teams, suppliers, and external stakeholders. External Regulatory & Certification Leadership Strong ability to technically present, defend, and substantiate avionics subsystem designs and verification evidence with external regulatory and certification authorities, including NASA, ESA, and other government agencies, supporting spacecraft qualification, safety, and flight certification. Verification & Validation Define and support verification and validation strategies for avionics systems. Participate in simulation, hardware-in-the-loop (HIL), and system-level testing activities. Analyze test results, identify anomalies, and drive corrective actions. Ensure compliance with system performance and reliability requirements. Requirements Engineering Capture, analyze, and manage system and subsystem requirements . Ensure full traceability from mission objectives to implementation and validation. Contribute to system documentation, including specifications, interface control documents, and test plans. Ensure compliance with applicable space standards and engineering best practices. Cross-functional Collaboration Work closely with software, hardware, systems, operations, and mission engineering teams. Participate in design reviews, technical exchanges, and system trade-off discussions. Support alignment with external partners, suppliers, and customers. Contribute to integration campaigns, launch preparation, and mission operations support. Strong understanding of: Electronic and embedded system architectures Communication and data handling principles System integration and interface management Experience with requirements engineering and system lifecycle development . Knowledge of verification and validation methods , including testing and simulation. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Ability to work in multidisciplinary engineering environments. jobs.description: Where Legal Leads.   Drei Worte.  Eine Überzeugung. Rechtsabteilungen sind nicht länger die Bremse im Unternehmen – sie sind der Hebel. Erstgespräche führen oft Legal Ops Manager oder General Counsel. Deals über mehrere Module sind bei uns die Regel.   Du repräsentierst DiliTrust auf den wichtigen Branchen-Events wie z.B. Legal Revolution oder LegalTech. Du führst dort die Gespräche, die später zu Pipeline werden.   Must-have 4+ Jahre Erfahrung im quotaverantwortlichen B2B-Software-Vertrieb, idealerweise im SaaS-Umfeld.   Erfahrung in komplexen Sales-Cycles mit mehreren Entscheidern aus Legal, IT, Finance oder Procurement.   Methodisches Arbeiten: Du qualifizierst sauber (z. B. mit MEDDPICC) und führst belastbare Forecasts.   Erfahrung im Verkauf an C-Level-Entscheider.   Deutsch auf Muttersprachen-Niveau, sehr gutes Englisch – unsere Unternehmenssprache ist Englisch.   Nice-to-have Erfahrung im Verkauf an Rechts-, Governance- oder Compliance-Funktionen.   Du kennst die Welt regulierter Branchen - Financial Services, Energy, Healthcare oder Pharma.   Du hast bereits eigenständig ein Territory aufgebaut – mit klarer Account-Strategie und nachhaltigem Pipeline-Aufbau.   Du interessierst dich für KI im Unternehmenskontext und kannst Kunden den Unterschied zwischen Hype und echtem Mehrwert erklären.   Was wir dir bieten Remote-First. jobs.title: Senior DevOps Engineer (all genders)
jobs.description: Sunday Natural is one of Germany’s fastest-growing natural health brands, and our eCommerce platform is growing with it – today it serves 7 million monthly active users , runs on €400k of AWS per year , and supports a development organization of 30+ engineers . Every one of those numbers has moved sharply upward in the last few years, and all of them will keep moving. You would be our first dedicated in-house Senior DevOps Engineer – and the two biggest engineering projects of the next two years are yours to help define and drive: bringing our entire infrastructure under Terraform, and strengthening the scalability, security and compliance posture across our cloud environments. Your role You shape the infrastructure vision. How we run, deploy, monitor and scale is yours to define, propose and defend. You work alongside our two external partners as the in-house technical counterpart – building the architecture and standards together, and bringing the deep platform knowledge back into the company. As the platform grows, taking the technical direction of that group is a natural next step, and one we would actively support. You own our AWS spend – €400k a year that currently has no dedicated owner, including where it goes and how we bring it down. You are the escalation point. When production is at risk, you decide. You report directly to the Head of eCommerce Platforms , with direct access to leadership for the decisions that need it. What you'll own AWS infrastructure – EC2, RDS, Fargate, CloudFront, S3, IAM – plus Cloudflare, DNS and WAF Security & compliance – DevSecOps practices, system audits, patching and access reviews, and GDPR-compliant data handling across every environment Infrastructure as code – taking us from manually managed to fully Terraform-defined Data layer – MySQL under production load: tuning, replication, and backups you have actually restored from Cloud economics – a €350k annual AWS budget with real headroom for optimisation Delivery for 30+ developers – Bitbucket Pipelines, environments, and how fast and safely code reaches production Reliability at 7M MAU – monitoring, logging, alerting and incident response (New Relic, Sentry, CloudWatch, PagerDuty) Your profile 7+ years running production infrastructure , with deep hands-on AWS as the person accountable when it breaks Security-conscious infrastructure operations – DevSecOps practices, system audits and access reviews, comfortable being accountable for GDPR-relevant data handling Infrastructure as code at scale – Terraform as your default way of working, on an estate of comparable size Deep Linux (Debian/Ubuntu) – you can trace a slow system from the kernel up and explain what you found MySQL under real load – slow-query analysis, replication, indexing, tested recovery Ownership of monitoring and incident response at scale – you have built the alerting that catches problems before customers report them, using tooling like New Relic, Datatog, etc. and run the on-call and post-incident process around it Experience defining standards that other engineers work to , whether with in-house teams or external partners, and holding the line on them Nice to have PHP-FPM / Magento 2 performance tuning, or Varnish and Redis at scale Cloud cost optimisation at six-figure annual spend AWS architecture certification Experience with SIEM tooling (e.g. Wazuh) or similar security monitoring Background in direct-to-consumer eCommerce or other high-traffic system operations Our stack Magento 2 · PIM · PHP · MySQL · Redis · Varnish · Docker · AWS · Terraform · Bitbucket Pipelines · New Relic · Sentry · CloudWatch · jobs.title: FullStack Engineer - Prospect UI Solutions
jobs.description: About You You have a knack for solving intricate Software Development problems. You're driven by the idea of writing code that simplifies life for millions of users globally. You're committed to continuous learning and enjoy tackling new challenges. Pair programming, code reviews, and collaborative brainstorming with a team are activities you find fulfilling. You're eager to work alongside developers, prospective customers, account executives, product managers, data scientists, and data analysts. You're a disciplined professional who consistently delivers high-quality code that you take full ownership of, communicates technical solutions with clarity and empathy, and takes the initiative to streamline processes for your team and yourself. About Us Constructor is the next-generation platform for search and discovery in ecommerce, built on a unique GPT-based architecture made specifically for commerce. Constructor's AI-first solutions make it easier for shoppers to discover products they want to buy and for ecommerce teams to deliver highly personalized experiences, from search, to recommendations, to AI Shopping Agents and everything in between. Optimizing specifically for ecommerce metrics like revenue, conversion rate and profit, Constructor generates consistent $10M+ lifts for some of the biggest brands in ecommerce, such as Sephora, Petco, Under Armour, home24, Birkenstock and The Very Group. Constructor is a U.S. based company that has been in the market since 2019. It was founded by Eli Finkelshteyn and Dan McCormick who still lead the company today. We’re a passionate team who love solving problems and want to make our customers’ and coworkers’ lives better. We value empathy, openness, curiosity, continuous improvement, and are excited by metrics that matter. We believe that empowering everyone in a company to do what they think is best can lead to great things. About the Position As a Software Engineer on the Prospect UI Solutions team, you will play a pivotal role in proving how Constructor will enhance the website discovery experiences for prospects. You’ll work closely with internal Engineering, Product and Sales stakeholders to seamlessly integrate prospective customer data with our services, supporting them to create an optimized and accurate product discovery demo. In this role, you will: Fuel our proprietary AI models: Write JavaScript code to collect data essential for training our AI. Leverage Modern Tooling: Utilize AI as a tool to accelerate your fundamental capabilities and knowledge on how to solve problems with software; building solutions that you are proud to call your own Seal the deal : Collaborate with Data Analysts and Account Executives to secure deals with prominent e-commerce brands. Leverage your tech knowledge: Assist prospects in integrating their data and user interfaces with our services, focusing on ETL and front-end integrations. Deliver excellence: Validate the data provided by prospects and ensure the quality of the results returned by our services. Empower a sales force: Contribute to the development and scaling of demo infrastructure to enhance the demo capabilities of the Sales team. Be a part of the answer: Assist Account Executives by addressing technical inquiries from prospects about our services. Elevate the team: Provide support to your teammates through thoughtful code reviews and empathetic problem solving sessions. Visualize brilliance: Develop dashboards and alerts using React, Redux, Node, Clickhouse and OpenSearch. Innovate with purpose: Implement and test new features for our open-source JavaScript UI libraries and REST clients . Collaborative contribution: Steer cross-team efforts to ensure our prospect's needs are at the forefront of our priorities, making you a key player in our strategic success. Champion team culture : Actively foster our team’s sense of community by expanding our roster of Friday team-building games and promoting a culture of empathy, personal growth

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer
jobs.description: Your Role We are looking for a Senior Data Engineer (f/m/d) at LIQID, who will play a pivotal role in building and scaling data infrastructure that powers decision-making. You will design scalable, high-performance data pipelines, ensure data integrity, and drive efficient data processing across the organization. Working closely with our Head of Data, Analytics Engineers, and cross-functional teams, you will develop robust data architectures, enhance data security, and implement best practices that empower data-driven decision-making at scale. This is not a role where you preserve what already exists. It is a role where you build what comes next. As LIQID scales beyond €4 billion in assets under management, the demands on our data infrastructure are growing fast. You will have real ownership over how we meet that challenge, with the autonomy to propose solutions and the backing to ship them. What will keep you challenged? Design, build, and optimize scalable data pipelines and storage solutions that ensure efficient, secure, and reliable data processing from source systems to our data warehouse Develop and manage ETL/ELT workflows to integrate data from multiple sources, ensuring seamless ingestion, transformation, and availability Implement and enforce data quality, validation, and monitoring processes to guarantee accuracy and integrity for analytics and operational use cases Ensure data security and compliance by applying best practices and industry standards for handling sensitive information Collaborate with analysts, product managers, and engineers to understand data needs and deliver solutions that unlock new insights Continuously evaluate and integrate new technologies to improve scalability, performance, and future-proof LIQID’s data infrastructure What you bring Over 5 years of professional experience in data engineering, data architecture, or a similar data related role Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field Strong proficiency in SQL, Python and ETL/ELT frameworks, with experience in data modelling, warehousing, and database management (e.g., BigQuery, Snowflake, PostgreSQL) Experience with cloud data platforms (e.g., AWS, Google Cloud) and modern data pipeline tools (e.g., Airflow, dbt) Solid understanding of data modelling principles to meet data governance, security, and compliance best practices and ensure safe and scalable data operations FinTech experience is a plus, but a strong interest in financial services and data-driven decision-making is essential Experience using AI coding tools (Copilot, Cursor, Claude) to speed up development and integrating them into standard workflows (code review, CI/CD), with the judgment to verify output, not just ship it. Experience with data quality testing frameworks or rules-as-code approaches (e.g. dbt tests, Great Expectations) to catch issues before they hit production. Experience with streaming/near-real-time pipelines (Kafka, Kinesis, or similar) is a plus. Fluent in English, both written and spoken; German is a plus What we offer Diversity : Flat hierarchies and cultural openness make you an integral part of our diverse team of international talents from day one. Flexibility : We don’t complicate your life. You’ll find the right balance with flexible work models, working hours, and remote work options. 28 days of vacation and two additional days off on December 24 and 31 ensure you have ample time to unwind. Appreciation : You’ll help shape the future of digital wealth management with us in an innovative, multi-award-winning company on a growth trajectory, with high market relevance and plenty of space for your ideas. Development : We support your personal and professional growth with an annual development budget of €1,500. jobs.title: Team Lead Software Production Support (m/f/d)
jobs.description: At Quantum Systems, we are redefining the boundaries of autonomous drone technology. We develop and deploy some of the world’s most advanced UAVs, combining highly integrated hardware, embedded software, sensors, compute platforms, and production processes into reliable systems for demanding real-world missions.​ As part of our Software Production Support Team, you will work at the intersection of serial UAV production, embedded software, firmware deployment, production diagnostics, automation, and traceability. You will help ensure that every drone leaving production is equipped with the correct software, firmware, configuration, and documentation needed for safe and reliable operation.​ Between hands-on troubleshooting on the production floor, flashing microcontrollers and compute modules, analyzing system behavior, improving diagnostic workflows, developing production tools, and refining digital work instructions, you will play a key role in turning advanced UAV technology into stable, scalable, and efficient serial production What is your Day to Day Mission: Leading and developing the Software Production Support team​. Prioritizing urgent production support topics and long-term improvement activities​. Identifying bottlenecks, recurring issues, and process weaknesses in serial production​. Defining robust processes for microcontroller flashing, NVIDIA Orin installation, firmware updates, diagnostics, and recovery workflows​. Driving automation and standardization of software-related production steps​. Ensuring that production tools are reliable, versioned, documented, and maintainable​. jobs.title: Chief Product Officer (CPO) – Footwear (m/w/d)
jobs.description: Stellenbeschreibung Pammys ist in wenigen Jahren auf über 1,3 Millionen Kundinnen und Kunden gewachsen. Jetzt bauen wir die Product Organisation für unsere nächste Wachstumsphase: neue Kategorien, höhere Volumen, internationale Märkte und ein global skalierbares Produktionsnetzwerk. Dafür suchen wir einen Chief Product Officer (CPO) – Footwear (m/w/d), der unsere gesamte Product Organisation aufbaut, führt und auf das nächste Level bringt. Wir suchen keinen CPO, der Produkt nur aus Strategie-Meetings kennt. Wir suchen einen Builder und Operator mit tiefem Footwear-Know-how, der weiß, wie man Product Development, Engineering, Design, Merchandising, Sourcing, Production, Quality und Product Marketing zu einer leistungsfähigen Organisation verbindet. Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit den Gründern unsere langfristige Produkt- und Kategoriestrategie und verantwortest gleichzeitig, dass diese operativ funktioniert. Wenn ein Development-Prozess nicht funktioniert, gehst du rein. Wenn Qualität, Costing oder Timelines nicht stimmen, willst du verstehen warum und löst das Problem gemeinsam mit deinem Team. Wenn entscheidende Kompetenzen fehlen, baust du sie auf. Ein zentraler Bestandteil deiner Rolle ist der Aufbau unserer internationalen Product- und Sourcing-Struktur in China und perspektivisch weiteren Produktionsmärkten wie Vietnam. Dein Ziel ist klar: Bessere Produkte. Schnellere Entwicklungszyklen. Höhere Qualität. Stärkere Margen. Klare Ownership. Eine Product Organisation, die mit Pammys skalieren kann. Deine Aufgaben Du verantwortest die gesamte Product Organisation von Pammys und entwickelst Strukturen, Verantwortlichkeiten, Prozesse und Führung konsequent weiter. Du baust leistungsfähige Bereiche für Product Development & Engineering, Sourcing & Production, Merchandising & Planning, Footwear Design, Product Management, Quality sowie Product Marketing & Consumer Insights auf. Du rekrutierst, führst und entwickelst starke Führungskräfte und Spezialisten und baust eine Organisation, die nicht dauerhaft vom CPO abhängig ist. Du verantwortest gemeinsam mit den Gründern die langfristige Product- und Category Strategy und entscheidest, welche Kategorien, Silhouetten und Produktwelten Pammys zukünftig aufbaut. Du steuerst den gesamten Produktentwicklungsprozess von der ersten Idee über Design, Construction, Material Selection, Sampling, Fit und Testing bis zur Serienproduktion und Markteinführung. Du optimierst unsere Entwicklungsprozesse mit dem Ziel, Development Timelines zu verkürzen, Iterationen zu reduzieren und Produkte schneller zur Production Readiness zu bringen. Du entwickelst unser internationales Factory- und Supplier Network weiter und führst strategische Verhandlungen zu Costing, Kapazitäten, Qualität, Lead Times und Produktionsbedingungen. Du baust gemeinsam mit uns unsere Product-, Development- und Sourcing-Präsenz in China auf und entwickelst dort langfristig ein leistungsfähiges lokales Team. Du etablierst klare QA- und QC-Strukturen und stellst sicher, dass definierte Qualitätsstandards nicht nur auf dem Papier existieren, sondern in der Produktion konsequent umgesetzt werden. Du verantwortest gemeinsam mit Merchandising & Planning die kommerzielle Steuerung unseres Portfolios über Target Cost, Einkaufspreise, Verkaufspreise, Margen, Mengen, Launch-Zeitpunkte und Produktprofitabilität. Du etablierst klare Product Ownership, sodass jedes relevante Produkt einen verantwortlichen Owner hat, der Development, Design, Sourcing, Quality und Launch über alle Funktionen hinweg vorantreibt. Du verknüpfst Produktentwicklung stärker mit Consumer Insights und Marketing und stellst sicher, dass neue Produkte auf reale Kundenbedürfnisse, klare Positionierung und kommerzielles Skalierungspotenzial ausgerichtet sind. Du arbeitest regelmäßig direkt mit unseren Teams, Fabriken und Produktionspartnern in Asien und steigst bei kritischen Themen auch selbst tief in operative Produkt- und Produktionsfragen ein. Dein Profil

jobs.title: Analyst Early Stage Team
jobs.description: Analyst Early Stage Investment Team (m/f/d) - Berlin, Munich, London HV Capital is one of Europe's largest generalist VCs. We invest from pre-seed through growth, across SaaS, fintech, deep tech, and beyond. This is a seat inside the investment team, working directly with partners on sourcing, diligence, and portfolio support. What you'll actually work on Finding the next companies before anyone else does. Building market maps in sectors we're excited about, sourcing directly instead of waiting for inbound, running comps, and going deep enough on a space that you know it better than the partner sitting next to you. Running real diligence. Talking to founders, customers, and competitors. Building the model, not just filling in someone else's template. Stress-testing a business case instead of taking the deck at face value. Writing memos that make a case a partner would actually defend in an investment committee. Forming your own view, and holding it. We're still making bets on people as much as products, and that means judgment: reading a founder, reading a room, deciding whether you'd trust this person with your own money. That's a muscle, not a checklist. Sitting in the room, eventually. Partner meetings and deal reviews once you've earned it; not to run them, but to watch how a real investment decision actually gets made, and to have a sharp, well-formed view ready when someone asks for yours. Portfolio support. The odd KPI request, board-prep question, or research ask from a founder who needs a sharp answer fast, not a polished deck in two weeks. What good looks like here We evaluate analysts on judgment and reasoning (can you form an independent view and defend it under pushback), commercial acumen (do you actually understand what makes a business work), deal execution (can you run a process end to end from sourcing, modeling, diligence to closing support), and how you show up in the room. Ownership and curiosity matter as much as any of that. Chasing a thread nobody assigned you, following through without being asked twice. The craft still matters. A clean model, a memo that holds up, a process run properly. That's the baseline, not optional. What increasingly separates a good analyst from a great one on top of that is judgment: forming a view nobody handed you, and holding it under pushback. What we're looking for At least 2 -3 years of real work experience. Beyond that, we don't have one template. We've hired from strategy consulting, banking, asset management, the sciences, and straight out of operating roles at startups. What matters more than your last job title: can you form a view and defend it, can you read a room, do you have an actual edge instead of a template CV? jobs.title: Broker Development Manager
jobs.description: ABOUT FLOCK Road accidents kill and injure people, damage vehicles, and cost businesses fortunes. But traditional insurance does nothing to prevent them - it just pays out claims when they happen. At Flock, we’re changing that. Using telematics, AI, and real-time data, we proactively help our fleet customers prevent crashes. We obsessively focus on keeping drivers safe, and we put our money where our mouth is - paying out millions of pounds per year to fleets that get safer over time. We were acquired by Admiral in May 2026. Now we combine the backing of the UK’s leading motor insurer with startup energy and speed. We’re growing fast with bigger plans than ever, and we’re hugely optimistic that our approach will save many more lives in the decade ahead. We’re on a mission to make the world quantifiably safer. Join us! THE ROLE Our brokers play a crucial role in making this a reality. We’re an AI-first business, so whatever the role, we want people who reach for AI by default, stay curious about what it can do, and use it to work faster and think bigger. You’ll use AI day to day, from researching brokers to preparing for meetings, so more of your time goes on the conversations that win business. We’re looking for an ambitious and passionate Broker Development Manager to accelerate our distribution through brokers. In this role, you’ll maximise existing broker relationships and build strong, strategic, growth partnerships as part of our fast-paced distribution team right at the heart of Flock’s mission. WHAT WE THINK IS MOST EXCITING ABOUT THE ROLE: Be a part of building something truly game changing in the fleet market. You’ll manage a panel of key strategic brokers with significant growth opportunities. You’ll engage them on the market-leading benefits of Flock’s connected fleet proposition, and how together, we can reduce risk, improve costs and save lives. You’ll also have real freedom in how you use AI to work, whether that’s getting under the skin of a broker’s book before a meeting or spotting growth opportunities across your panel. A LITTLE MORE ON WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING: Act as a primary face of Flock for a panel of key broker partners, driving mutual growth and long-term success. Deliver high volumes of broker submissions, directly supporting Flock’s ambitious growth targets. Build, grow and develop our broker panel, onboarding new partners at pace and maximising their commercial potential. Proactively engage brokers, finding new and creative ways to promote Flock’s appetite and proposition as we expand into new sectors. Develop and execute clear, data-driven account growth strategies to drive sustained performance. Achieve strong conversion and retention by supporting day-to-day trading activity and helping brokers (and Flock) win and retain business. Work closely with internal teams, collaborating with brilliant Flockers across the business to deliver shared growth objectives. Maintain strong broker advocacy by being visible, responsive and passionate about Flock’s product, proposition and mission. Use AI in your day-to-day work, from broker research and meeting prep to analysing your pipeline, so your time goes on relationships rather than admin. WHAT YOU’LL BRING TO FLOCK: ESSENTIAL A minimum of 5 years of experience in managing broker relationships within the insurance sector, possessing a reputable standing in the industry. Energy and innovation in abundance - the ability to work fast, spot opportunity and solve problems. A proven track record of exceeding revenue targets, driving business growth, and closely collaborating with cross-functional teams to achieve collective objectives. An existing network of broker contacts that will enable a rapid integration and immediate impact within Flock’s business development realm. Motorway is backed by some of the world’s leading technology investors, having raised £143 million in Series C funding. This is a unique opportunity to join a fast-growing scale-up at a crucial phase of growth and help change an industry for the better. We're looking for a Senior Total Reward Analyst to own compensation, equity, and commission across the business - reporting directly to the CPO and working closely with senior leadership and Finance. This is a broad, hands-on remit with real influence. You'll bring structure to how we pay and reward our people, use AI tooling as a core part of how you work, and help shape a rewards function that scales with us. Run the annual merit cycle and gender pay gap reporting, partnering with the CPO, People Partners, and Finance. jobs.title: Senior Product Manager (Data APIs)
jobs.description: About 9fin 9fin is the AI platform powering global debt markets — the world’s largest asset class at over $145 trillion. Debt markets are vast, global, and mission-critical, yet still run on fragmented data, PDFs, and manual workflows. 9fin replaces this broken infrastructure with a single platform that centralises proprietary credit data, deep analysis, and high-value workflows across global markets. Today, 9fin powers teams at 300+ blue-chip institutions worldwide, including global banks, asset managers, private equity firms, law firms, and advisors. The business is scaling at exceptional speed, with rapid expansion in the US and best-in-class retention driven by deep workflow adoption. We’re at a defining inflection point. With proven product-market fit and strong, global market pull, 9fin is accelerating toward becoming the category-defining platform for debt markets worldwide. The Opportunity 9fin has built one of the most comprehensive datasets in credit and debt markets: news, financials, cap tables, instrument data, legal documents, and ESG analysis. Today, most clients access that data through 9fin.com . But a large and growing segment of the market wants to consume our data programmatically to power firm-level workflows at scale: a negative news signal triggers an automated credit review, updated financials trigger a portfolio rebalance, a covenant keyword triggers a sanctions flag. These buyers (quant desks, data engineering teams, systematic investors, risk and compliance functions) will never log into a web application. They need APIs, data feeds, and cloud-native delivery through platforms like Snowflake. At comparable financial data providers, this distribution channel represents 20-30% of total revenue. 9fin is at the beginning of this journey. The challenge is to turn 9fin's integrated dataset into a portfolio of standalone data products with a coherent commercial strategy. You will define how the data gets packaged (what goes together, what stands alone, how it's tiered and priced), the order in which products go to market, and the commercial models that fit each buyer segment: quant desks, data engineering teams, risk and compliance functions, and systematic investors. You will work in lockstep with the Head of Pre-Sales, who owns technical validation and deal execution, to ensure that what you build maps to how these buyers actually evaluate and procure data. The first candidates pan news content, financials and cap tables, instrument data, and legal data (complex, high-value, and genuinely unsolved at the data representation layer). You will work cross-functionally across our platform teams, analytics engineering, and the domain squads that own the underlying datasets. You will also work closely with Sales to support a fundamentally different GTM motion: solution-selling with partner clients, joint POCs, multi-stakeholder deals, and usage-based commercial models rather than seat-based subscriptions. This is a 0-to-1 build. If you have built API or data products before and want to do it again in a market where the opportunity is wide open, this is it. What You'll Do Product Strategy & Execution Define the product vision and strategy for 9fin's external data distribution: APIs, data shares, and future delivery mechanisms (cloud sync, pub/sub). Own the data catalogue decisions: which datasets to expose, in what format, through which channels, and in what order, balancing client demand, data readiness, and commercial potential Design the developer experience end-to-end: API design, documentation, developer portal, sandbox/playground, error handling, rate limiting, and versioning Work with analytics engineering and domain teams to define schemas, data models, and transformation logic that make 9fin's data consumable and valuable outside the application Use a partner model to validate early: select and work closely with 1-2 clients during development to co-develop and prove out each data product before broad

jobs.description: Location: Remote in Europe Salary: Competitive base + Commission About Nivoda 🚀 Nivoda is a rapidly scaling global B2B diamond and gemstone marketplace connecting jewellery retailers with competitive, high-quality suppliers worldwide. Processing $300M+ in annual transactions and operating across multiple regions, Nivoda is transforming a $350B industry that has historically been slow to modernise. Our platform gives businesses of all sizes, from independent jewellers to major retail chains access to the world's best diamond and gemstone inventory, without the traditional barriers of capital, geography, or information asymmetry. Our Mission 🎯 Diamond and gemstone trading has long been plagued by inefficiency, opacity, and exclusivity. Nivoda was built to change that - to democratise access and empower every business, regardless of size or location, to buy and sell with confidence. Independent jewellers are at the heart of this mission. They deserve the same access to quality, pricing, and selection as the biggest players in the industry. That's exactly what we give them. The Team ⭐️ Our Sales team is the engine that brings Nivoda's mission to life. We're a high-energy, globally distributed group that moves fast, owns outcomes, and genuinely cares about the success of every jewellery business we work with. This is a team that thrives on commercial creativity, deep customer relationships, and relentless execution and we're growing fast. About the Role 🤔 You are the front of the machine: you take inbound leads and hunt outbound prospects, qualify them fast, and get a demo on the AE's calendar. Your job ends when the demo is booked and confirmed — everything before that moment is yours. This is a high-velocity, transactional sales role. Think SaaS SDR playbook: tight cadences, high activity volume, sharp qualification, relentless follow-up. You will run multichannel sequences (phone, email, WhatsApp, LinkedIn), work a CRM with discipline, and be measured weekly on activity and demos held. What will you be doing? 😎 Work inbound leads within SLA (minutes, not hours) and convert them to booked demos. Build and execute outbound sequences against target retailer lists; personalise at speed, not at leisure. Qualify hard: right buyer type, purchase volume, intent, timeline. Kill bad leads quickly. Book, confirm, and protect the demo — reduce no-shows with reminders and pre-demo touches. Keep the CRM immaculate: every touch logged, every lead dispositioned, pipeline data trustworthy. Feed learnings back: objections heard, messaging that lands, segments that convert. What do we need from you? 💪 1–3 years in a SaaS or tech-sales SDR/BDR role with a transactional, high-volume motion — short cycles, big numbers, daily intensity. jobs.title: Product & Brand Designer
jobs.description: V7 At V7, we’re building AI platforms that help humans do their best work, at incredible scale and speed. Our mission is to turn human knowledge into trustworthy AI, making complex tasks faster, smarter, and more accurate. We’re growing fast, backed by leading investors and AI pioneers (including the minds behind Transformers and Gemini). The team you'll be joining and impact you'll have You'll own how V7 looks and feels to the world, across both the marketing site and the product itself. This is a product and brand design role first: you'll be setting the visual direction, designing the product experience and making sure the two hang together. Our design team is small and sits close to engineering. Designers here work directly with the people building the product, and the loop between a design decision and it appearing in the codebase is short. A lot of this currently sits with contractors or is spread thinly across the team. You'll pull it in-house and become the person who owns the brand and the product's design language. You'll help shape our design system and the front-end refactor that sits underneath it, defining the components and patterns everyone else builds on. Engineering will do the heavy lifting on implementation, but you'll be the one deciding what good looks like. What you'll be doing from day one: Own the marketing site end to end in Framer, including the parts most people skip: CMS collections, dynamic content, responsive behaviour and interaction states. Design product UI against our design system, from early exploration through to polished, buildable specs, working alongside engineers rather than throwing designs over the wall. Define motion and interaction: animation, empty and loading states, transitions, and the detail that makes a product feel finished. Where it's quicker to tweak it yourself in the codebase, you can. Take on genuinely new surfaces that don't have a pattern yet, like visualising the Context Graph: nodes, edges, and how a knowledge graph should actually read on screen. Run an AI-first workflow: exploring variants in Claude Design, generating specs in Cursor, using whatever tooling gets you from idea to something real fastest. Fast because of the tooling, not despite it. Who you are You're a product and brand designer with real craft. Your portfolio shows strong visual instincts and thoughtful product thinking, and you can hold a coherent direction across web, marketing and product. You know Framer properly, CMS collections and all, and you can build a page that looks good and reads well without hand-holding, with the kind of animation and polish that lifts a brand. You can work inside a design system: extending components, keeping things consistent, and knowing when something genuinely needs a new pattern versus reusing what's there. You're comfortable enough around code that opening a pull request in Cursor or similar to fix a spacing issue or adjust a component doesn't scare you. That's a bonus, not the job. You're a designer who can get hands-on when it helps, not an engineer who happens to design. You treat AI tooling as core to how you work, using it to amplify your output and move faster rather than keeping it at arm's length. V7 champions equality and inclusion because diverse teams build better products. Don't check every box? Apply anyway — we value what makes you unique and will support you through the process, just let our Talent team know how they can help. You're eager to learn, naturally analytical, and comfortable leading complex sales cycles. Located in Europe, with travel required internationally as needed.   This role is fully remote, ideally located in Paris.     What You'll Do Own and expand strategic relationships with holding company leaders and teams across Data, Analytics, Investment, Programmatic and Ad Tech sectors in Southern Europe, positioning Samba and Semasio as an invaluable partner.
